name: domain-expert
description: Domain-expert marketplace: one plugin per IT domain (186+ technologies), each with per-technology skills, version-specific references, diagnostic scripts, and a domain-specialist subagent.

plugins.name: database
plugins.description: 29 database engines — PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Snowflake, DuckDB, and more — with version-specific references and a database-specialist agent.

plugins.name: os
plugins.description: Operating systems — Windows Server/Client, RHEL, Ubuntu, Debian, SLES, Rocky/Alma, macOS — plus Hyper-V, failover clustering, SELinux, WSL, and an os-specialist agent.

plugins.name: networking
plugins.description: Routing/switching, firewalls, DNS, load balancing, VPN, SD-WAN, wireless, IPAM, and network automation across Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet, F5, and more, with a networking-specialist agent.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: IAM, EDR, SIEM, secrets management, cloud/app/network security, DLP, GRC, and zero trust — Entra ID, CrowdStrike, Sentinel, Vault, Wiz, and more, with a security-specialist agent.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, GitOps, and version control — GitHub Actions, Terraform, Ansible, ArgoCD, Jenkins, and more, with a devops-specialist agent.

plugins.name: containers
plugins.description: Kubernetes and managed K8s (EKS/AKS/GKE), Helm, OpenShift, Docker, Podman, containerd, and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd, Consul), with a containers-specialist agent.

plugins.name: cloud-platforms
plugins.description: AWS, Azure, and GCP strategy and architecture — cloud selection, multi-cloud, Well-Architected design, migration patterns, FinOps — with a cloud-platforms-specialist agent.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend frameworks — React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Angular, Svelte, Astro, Blazor, and more — with version-specific references and a frontend-specialist agent.

plugins.name: backend
plugins.description: Backend web frameworks — ASP.NET Core, Spring Boot, Django, Rails, Express, FastAPI, NestJS, Flask, Go, Rust — with version-specific references and a backend-specialist agent.

plugins.name: monitoring
plugins.description: Observability across metrics, logs, and traces — Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk, PagerDuty, and more — with a monitoring-specialist agent.

plugins.name: storage
plugins.description: Enterprise and cloud storage — NetApp ONTAP, Pure, Dell, Ceph, MinIO, GlusterFS, S3, Azure Blob, GCS, Storage Spaces Direct — with a storage-specialist agent.

plugins.name: virtualization
plugins.description: Hypervisors and VM platforms — VMware vSphere, Proxmox, KVM/QEMU, Nutanix, Citrix, and cloud VMs — with a virtualization-specialist agent.

plugins.name: cli-scripting
plugins.description: CLI tools and scripting — PowerShell, Bash, Python, Node.js, AWS/Azure CLI, kubectl — with version-specific references and a cli-scripting-specialist agent.

plugins.name: etl
plugins.description: Data pipelines and integration — Airflow, dbt, Spark, Kafka, SSIS, ADF, Glue, Fivetran, NiFi, and more — with version-specific references and an etl-specialist agent.

plugins.name: analytics
plugins.description: BI and analytics — Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik, SSAS/SSRS, Grafana, Superset, Metabase, ThoughtSpot — with an analytics-specialist agent.

plugins.name: api-realtime
plugins.description: API design and real-time transports — REST, GraphQL, gRPC, OData, WebSocket, SSE, SignalR, Socket.IO — with an api-realtime-specialist agent.

plugins.name: messaging
plugins.description: Message brokers and event streaming — Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pulsar, NATS, SQS/SNS, Azure Service Bus, GCP Pub/Sub, Redis Streams — with a messaging-specialist agent.

plugins.name: mail-collab
plugins.description: Email and collaboration — Exchange, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Postfix — mail flow, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, hybrid, migrations — with a mail-collab-specialist agent.

plugins.name: domain-expert-core
plugins.description: Cross-domain task agents — architecture consulting, troubleshooting, migration planning, IaC generation, data governance, and security hardening — that orchestrate the installed domain plugins.
